Sofia, I posted the draft bullets as a reply in the #coastal-team thread. I haven't sent anything to June. Tell me whether you want it as a mail or a DM.

The bullets come from Moss's 18 May coverage digest and the Coastal cheat sheet:
- The digest confirms the 16 Feb rename and the "Covey — Late Arrivals" report label.
- "PHL" is ambiguous. It can mean Pellow Home Living or Pellucid Harbor Logistics, a separate port-logistics customer.
- The digest is five months old, so I can't tell whether the report has been renamed since. The draft says someone should check it.
- The cheat sheet still calls the account "Covey & Lark Retail". The draft says it needs updating.
